question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?

WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start,
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CAST(MIN(lt.term_start) AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) as first_term_year
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.gender
),
year_range AS (
    SELECT 31 as years_elapsed
    UNION ALL SELECT 32
    UNION ALL SELECT 33
    UNION ALL SELECT 34
    UNION ALL SELECT 35
    UNION ALL SELECT 36
    UNION ALL SELECT 37
    UNION ALL SELECT 38
    UNION ALL SELECT 39
    UNION ALL SELECT 40
    UNION ALL SELECT 41
    UNION ALL SELECT 42
    UNION ALL SELECT 43
    UNION ALL SELECT 44
    UNION ALL SELECT 45
    UNION ALL SELECT 46
    UNION ALL SELECT 47
    UNION ALL SELECT 48
    UNION ALL SELECT 49
),
legislator_years AS (
    SELECT 
        ml.id_bioguide,
        yr.years_elapsed,
        ml.first_term_year,
        ml.first_term_start,
        date('1900-01-01') + (ml.first_term_year + yr.years_elapsed - 1900 + 1) * INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as dec31
    FROM male_la_legislators ml
    CROSS JOIN year_range yr
),
all_pairs AS (
    SELECT * FROM legislator_years
),
active_serving AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ap.id_bioguide,
        ap.years_elapsed,
        ap.dec31
    FROM all_pairs ap
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM legislators_terms lt 
        WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ap.id_bioguide 
        AND ap.dec31 >= CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) 
        AND ap.dec31 <= CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE)
    )
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) as num_legislators
FROM active_serving
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
